items.title_cn: 使用AI规划后量子迁移路线
items.title_en: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration
items.title_original: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration
items.what_happened: Cloudflare正在使用AI推动其后量子迁移，目标在2029年前实现全面后量子就绪。许多产品已使用后量子加密，但后量子认证仍有待完成。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare is using AI to drive its post-quantum migration, targeting full post-quantum readiness by 2029. Many products already use post-quantum encryption, but post-quantum authentication remains to be done.
items.why_it_matters: 后量子迁移使互联网流量能够抵御量子对手。
items.why_it_matters_en: Post-quantum migration future-proofs internet traffic against quantum adversaries.

items.title_cn: 请更新：苹果 iOS / iPadOS 26.7.1 修复高危漏洞，恶意文件可触发代码执行
items.title_en: Update now: Apple iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1 fixes high-risk flaw allowing code execution via malicious file
items.title_original: 请更新：苹果 iOS / iPadOS 26.7.1 修复高危漏洞，恶意文件可触发代码执行
items.what_happened: 苹果推送 iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1，修复 CoreGraphics 中的 CVE-2026-86950 越界写入漏洞，恶意文件可触发任意代码执行。苹果表示已有证据表明漏洞正被活跃利用，SlowMist 称攻击者已利用该漏洞攻击加密钱包应用。受影响设备包括 iPhone 11 及更新机型和多款 iPad；用户可安装 iOS 26.7.1 或升级到 iOS 27。
items.what_happened_en: Apple released iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1, fixing CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics that lets a malicious file trigger arbitrary code execution. Apple said there is evidence of active exploitation, and SlowMist said attackers used the flaw against crypto wallet apps. Affected devices include iPhone 11 and later and listed iPad models; users can install iOS 26.7.1 or upgrade to iOS 27.
items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞正被活跃利用且影响大量 iPhone 和 iPad，及时更新对设备安全至关重要。
items.why_it_matters_en: The flaw is actively exploited and affects a broad set of iPhones and iPads, so prompt updating matters for device security.

items.title_cn: 为整个互联网构建证书颁发机构
items.title_en: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet
items.title_original: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet
items.what_happened: Cloudflare 宣布有意成为公共证书颁发机构，已申请加入 Chrome、Apple、Microsoft 和 Mozilla 根证书计划，并签署最终协议从 GlobalSign 收购一个成熟且被广泛信任的根。该公司还表示计划成为首批提供后量子服务的 CA 之一。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare announced its intent to become a public certificate authority, applied for inclusion in the Chrome, Apple, Microsoft and Mozilla root programs, and signed a definitive agreement to acquire an established, broadly trusted root from GlobalSign. It also said it plans to be one of the first CAs to serve post-quantum.
items.why_it_matters: Cloudflare 长期是公共可信证书的最大使用者之一；自行颁发证书可能改变 TLS 信任与后量子证书覆盖最广泛设备的方式。
items.why_it_matters_en: Cloudflare has long been one of the largest consumers of publicly trusted certificates; issuing its own could change how TLS trust and post-quantum certificates reach the widest possible device base.

items.why_it_matters: 这扩大了NASA的商业发射选择。
items.why_it_matters_en: It expands NASA's commercial launch options.

items.title_cn: 气候行动学习实验室为有效气候解决方案连接研究与政策

items.title_original: Climate Action Learning Lab bridges research and policy for effective climate solutions
items.what_happened: MIT新闻报告称，J-PAL北美学习实验室为有效气候解决方案连接研究与政策。
items.what_happened_en: MIT News reports that J-PAL North America’s Learning Lab bridges research and policy for effective climate solutions.
items.why_it_matters: 连接研究与政策可以加速有效的气候行动。
items.why_it_matters_en: Bridging research and policy can accelerate effective climate action.

items.why_it_matters_en: It marks a crewed spaceflight milestone.

items.title_cn: 加压实验可能帮助风电场产生更多电力
items.title_en: Pressurized experiments could help wind farms generate more power
items.title_original: Pressurized experiments could help wind farms generate more power
items.what_happened: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种在现场模拟风力涡轮机的新方法，表明调整涡轮机运行可以释放更多电力。
items.what_happened_en: MIT researchers developed a new way of simulating wind turbines in the field, showing that tweaking turbine operation could unlock more power.
items.why_it_matters: 这些发现提出了一种可能提高现有风电场能量输出的方法。
items.why_it_matters_en: The findings suggest a potential method to increase energy output from existing wind farms.

items.title_cn: 我们用前沿 AI 模型测试了自家 WAF，结果如下
items.title_en: We tested our own WAF with frontier AI models. Here’s what we found
items.title_original: We tested our own WAF with frontier AI models. Here’s what we found
items.what_happened: Cloudflare 用前沿 AI 模型测试了自家 WAF，采用动态方法，让 LLM 扮演黑客角色且无法查看源代码。该公司指出，LLM 迭代和变异攻击载荷的速度超过任何人类黑客。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare tested its own WAF with frontier AI models, using a dynamic approach in which the LLM acted as a hacker with no visibility into source code. It noted LLMs can iterate and mutate attack payloads faster than any human hacker.
items.why_it_matters: 该测试考察 WAF 是否已准备好应对能快速变异攻击的前沿 AI 模型，这对网络安全团队具有实际意义。
items.why_it_matters_en: The test examines whether WAFs are ready for frontier AI models that can rapidly mutate attacks, a practical question for web security teams.

items.title_cn: 使用视觉 AI 研究城市的希望与风险

items.title_original: The promise and peril of using visual AI to study cities
items.what_happened: MIT Senseable City Lab 负责人在新书《How AI Sees the City》中探讨了该技术对城市研究的影响。
items.what_happened_en: In their new book, “How AI Sees the City,” the leaders of MIT’s Senseable City Lab examine the technology’s implications for research on cities.
items.why_it_matters: 该书探讨了使用视觉 AI 研究城市的希望与风险，对城市研究和政策具有参考意义。
items.why_it_matters_en: The book examines both the promise and peril of using visual AI to study cities, relevant to urban research and policy.
